description: Patrol: Border Beat: radio lead-in, calls and sign-offs.

briefing: Four beacons along the border of {system}. Check each. Things have been quiet and that is why {client} is nervous.
Border patrol. Hold at each beacon until it clears. Report contacts.
success: Patrol complete. The border is as you found it, mostly.
failure: The patrol is broken up. {client} will send someone else.
You fail to complete the beat.
radio-beats: Four beacons to check. First is ahead.
Patrol begins. Hold close to each beacon.
radio-trouble: Contacts on the far side. Five, one a gunship.
Hostiles on the border. They were waiting.
{enemy} wing on your beat. Do not let it stop the scan.
radio-more: They have a second group. Rear.
